description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultMetadataHeader class, which implements the MetadataHeader interface. It provides methods for creating, comparing, serializing, and deserializing metadata header objects, including JSON parsing and handling of header keys and values.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeader
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MetadataHeader, representing a metadata header with key and value, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization and comparison.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultMetadataHeader instance with specified key and value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a DefaultMetadataHeader from a JSON object, extracting key and value fields.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this header with another based on key and value.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the header to a JSON object.
